name: commando_exec
description: Preferred way to execute a shell command on a managed Commando target. If the result text ends with a line `[streaming] next_page=<token>`, the command is still running — pass the token to commando_output to get more output.

timeout.description: Command timeout in seconds (default: 300). Increase for long-running operations like bulk disk maintenance, large backups, or commands iterating over many targets.
